title: ChimeraTK JSON Map (jmap) file
description: Schema for ChimeraTK .jmap files. Strict: only documented fields allowed, except '_...' comment keys inside entries, which are ignored everywhere.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value metadata. '_...' keys are treated as comments and skipped by the parser.

interruptHandler.description: Interrupt handler config, keyed by numeric interrupt-ID (e.g. '0', '3'). Each value is an INTC controller with optional nested 'subhandler' entries.

propertyNames.description: Interrupt IDs are non-negative integers, e.g. '0', '3'.

addressSpace.description: Main hierarchical dictionary of registers/modules. Modules have 'children'; registers have 'address'.

if.description: If any register declares a 'triggeredByInterrupt' with two or more entries (i.e. a chained interrupt that must resolve through a controller), an 'interruptHandler' section must be present. A single-entry array like [13] is just the raw hardware interrupt and needs no handler entry.

addressSpaceContainsInterrupt.description: Matches an address-space entry iff it, or any of its nested 'children' (recursively), declares a 'triggeredByInterrupt' with at least two entries. Used by the top-level conditional to require 'interruptHandler' whenever a chained interrupt needs to resolve through a controller.

addressSpaceEntry.description: A register and/or module. A register has an 'address' (and either a flat 'representation' for scalar/1D registers or 'channels' + 'pitch' for 2D registers). A module has 'children'. Field order: engineeringUnit, description, access, triggeredByInterrupt, numberOfElements, bytesPerElement, pitch, address, representation, then channels/children.

access.description: RO/WO, or RW (default). Mutually exclusive with 'triggeredByInterrupt'.

triggeredByInterrupt.description: Non-empty list of interrupt IDs that trigger this register, e.g. [3, 9, 0]. The last entry is the raw hardware interrupt (not checked); every preceding entry must resolve through the 'interruptHandler' chain: the first is a top-level key, each following one a 'subhandler' key of the previous entry. A single-entry array like [13] is just the hardware interrupt and needs no handler entry. Implies INTERRUPT/read-only; exclusive with 'access'.

pitch.description: Byte pitch between two samples of the same channel of a 2D register. Required when 'channels' is present.

selectedBy.description: Register-level mux selector for scalar/1D (non-2D, no 'channels') registers: the whole register is active when the 'register' equals 'value'. For 2D registers use per-channel 'selectedBy' instead; having both is an error.

channels.description: Channels of a 2D register, keyed by name. When present the register must have a 'pitch'; its 'address' is either given explicitly or inherited from the parent.

children.description: Nested address-space entries (sub-registers or sub-modules). A child without an 'address' inherits the parent's address; its own 'representation' then reinterprets that same address, optionally using 'bitShift'+'width' to form a bit-field of the parent word. Children with an 'address' are independent sub-registers and can themselves have arbitrarily deep nested 'children'.

allOf.description: A VOID register is a pure interrupt source: it must have no 'address', and must declare a non-empty 'triggeredByInterrupt'.

A 2D register ('channels' present) needs a 'pitch' and must not combine its channels with a register-level 'selectedBy' (channels are muxed individually). Its 'address' may be given explicitly or inherited from the parent.

address.description: Hardware address of a register. An address present in a child entry overrides 'type'/'channel' and/or 'offset' of an inherited address; to inherit the whole parent address, omit this member entirely.

offset.description: Offset within the channel: integer or hex string like '0x8000'.

representation.description: How the register data is interpreted.

bitShift.description: LSB position of this field within the parent register or channel word.

channel.description: A named channel of a 2D register.

offset.description: Byte offset of the channel within the 2D register's sample.

selectedBy.description: Selects this channel by writing a value to a selection/mux register.

children.description: Nested bit-field children of this channel, keyed by name.

channelChild.description: A named bit-field child of a channel of a 2D register. Its 'representation' carries 'bitShift'+'width' relative to the channel word.

selectedBy.description: Selects a register or channel by writing a value to a separate selection/mux register. Active when that register equals 'value'.

register.description: Path of the selection/mux register, e.g. 'DAQ.MUX_SEL'.

value.description: Value written to 'register' to select this channel/register.

interruptHandlerEntry.description: An interrupt handler keyed by its interrupt ID, with the INTC/subhandler fields plus '_' comments.

options.description: Controller options, e.g. ['MER']. Allowed values: ISR, IER, MER, MIE, GIE, ICR, IAR, IPR, SIE, CIE, IMaskR, IModeR, IVR, ILR, IVAR, IVEAR.

subhandler.description: Nested sub-handlers, keyed by numeric sub-interrupt-ID string.
